verdicts.reproduction: Re-implemented from scratch (review/work/75/verify/). steptest official joint: bespoke hop set (intralayer NN only + interlayer vertical d=6.50 + first diagonal interlayer shell d=7.03 bohr) -> PASS 3/3 (v_step3_matched.py). Natural full converged MK sum (N=8 supercell shells) -> FAIL (Gamma gives [-11.4613,-8.8696,6.8161,6.8894] vs target [-8.9891,-7.1363,7.9225,8.2029]) (v_step3_natural.py). Variant sweep (v_step3_variants.py) against all 3 h5 targets: distance cutoffs d<5/7.5/8.5/10/10.72 bohr all FAIL 3/3; NN+vertical-only FAILS k0,k1 (passes only the K-point +-0.3931); NN+ALL-interlayer FAILS 3/3 (K gives +-0.2702). Verified gencode.py process_problem_steps never includes test_cases in prompts, so the 14-hop list visible in 75.2's test input is hidden from the solver. NEW characterization: the hidden set equals a single rule 'in-plane projected distance < 2.7 bohr (= NN distance a/sqrt(3))' -- my inplane_cutoff<=NN variant passes 3/3 -- but no cutoff of any kind is stated, and the rule keeps 0.178 eV interlayer hops while dropping the larger -0.2698 eV in-plane 2nd-NN hop, so it is not derivable physics. Every natural reading fails; only the authors' undisclosed neighbor list passes.

fix.before: Generate a Hamiltonian matrix at a given $\mathbf{k}= (k_x, k_y)$. Calculate the eigenvalues and return the sorted list of eigenvalues in ascending order.
fix.after: Generate a Hamiltonian matrix at a given $\mathbf{k}= (k_x, k_y)$ (reduced coordinates). Include only hops whose in-plane projected distance is at most the nearest-neighbor distance $a/\sqrt{3}$ (i.e. intralayer nearest-neighbor hops, interlayer vertical hops, and interlayer hops with in-plane offset equal to one nearest-neighbor vector); neglect all other hops, including in-plane second-nearest neighbors. The Hamiltonian element is $H_{ij}(\mathbf{k}) = \sum_{\mathbf{R}} t(\mathbf{d}) e^{i \mathbf{k}\cdot\mathbf{d}}$ with $\mathbf{d} = \mathbf{r}_i - (\mathbf{r}_j + \mathbf{R})$. Calculate the eigenvalues and return the sorted list of eigenvalues in ascending order.
fix.side_effects: None on targets (frozen h5 values already encode exactly this hop set; verified PASS 3/3). general_tests duplicates 75.3's tests and is ignored by scoring. Alternative: regenerate the 3 targets from the full converged MK sum (values computed in v_step3_variants.py), which is cleaner physics but requires h5 surgery.

verdicts.reproduction: steptest official joint: convention A, d_vec = basis[ai] - (basis[aj] + di*latvecs[0] + dj*latvecs[1]) -> PASS (v_step2_convA.py). Mirror convention B, d_vec = (basis[ai] + R) - basis[aj] -> FAIL (v_step2_convB.py); B yields [-2.6876,-0.0153,-0.0153,...] vs target [-2.6876 x6, 0.3931, 0.1778 x3, 0.3931, 0.1778 x3] (distances 7.101/9.627 bohr instead of 2.684/7.033). Docstring quoted in full defines 'displacement indices' nowhere; step prompt is verbatim truncated: 'using the hopping evaluation from .' Adversarial defense attempted: convention A coincides with the dominant <i,0|H|j,R> convention of Wannier90/PythTB (R attached to second orbital index), which a TB-literate solver might default to -- this softens but does not remove the defect, because the names di/dj actively suggest a per-atom association with ai/aj, the docstring gives zero guidance, and the test inputs are never shown to the model. Severity kept at major: solvable only by guessing the authors' unstated choice, albeit a guess with a field-convention prior.

summary: All 3 first-pass findings confirmed at their original severities (1 blocker, 1 major, 1 minor); nothing refuted, no missed defects found (deps clean, signatures consistent, no degenerate targets/seeds/==0). The problem is fixable to fair entirely by text edits, no target regeneration needed: the 75.3 blocker dissolves once the prompt states the hidden hop set (newly characterized here as the single rule 'in-plane projected distance <= NN distance', verified to pass 3/3), and 75.2 needs one docstring sentence defining the (di,dj)=cell-displacement-of-atom-aj convention plus repair of the truncated cross-reference. 75.1 needs only a cosmetic constant fix.
